description: This file provides a service class for integrating with the JIRA API, including methods for testing connectivity, retrieving project lists, and fetching project details. It manages authentication and uses external credentials management.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: Service class encapsulating methods for JIRA API interactions including connection testing and data retrieval.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_auth_headers(self, credentials: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Generates HTTP authorization headers based on provided credentials, supporting basic and API token methods.

methods.name: Tuple[ConnectionStatus,str] test_connection(self, base_url: str)
methods.description: Tests connection to a JIRA instance by making a request to the 'myself' API endpoint.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ProjectData],Optional[str]] get_projects(self, base_url: str)
methods.description: Fetches list of projects from the JIRA instance, returns project data objects or error message.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] get_project_details(self, base_url: str, project_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific JIRA project identified by its key.
